41/S0.subgoal: Describe the design objectives and the iterative development lifecycle used for the Majuli VR tour.

41/S1.subgoal: Explain the user categories, points of interest, and starting point design for the VR tour.

41/S2.subgoal: Describe how images and sounds were processed to improve the visual and auditory experience.

41/S3.subgoal: Explain the use of a virtual tablet interface for navigation and interaction.

41/S4.subgoal: Describe how the minimap and dual-map system provide orientation and wayfinding.

41/S5.subgoal: Explain techniques used for smooth transitions and long-distance travel, such as view interpolation and vehicle metaphors.

41/S6.subgoal: Describe how the system provides relevant video and textual information to users.

41/S7.subgoal: Explain how the design minimizes cyber-sickness through controlled navigation and smooth transitions.

41/S8.subgoal: Summarize the key design points of the lecture and preview the next topic.
